## Focaccia

Another one that I generally just go to King Arthur Flour for. I’ll probably add the details here eventually (especially if I make any changes or have comments), but I don’t think that KAF has an obnoxious website.


**Source:** [KingArthurFlour](https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/recipes/golden-focaccia-recipe)


**Ingredients:**


```{r}
#| label: focaccia
#| eval: false

dat <- tibble(
  Ingredients = c(
    "2 - 3 potatoes",
    "2-3 tbsp high-heat oil",
    "Spices to taste"
  ),
  spcr1 = " ",
  Tools = c(
    "Kitchen knife",
    "Mixing bowl",
    "Air fryer"
  )
)


colnames(dat)[str_detect(colnames(dat), "spcr")] <- ""

dat |> 
  tt(  theme = "striped" ) |> 
  style_tt(fontsize = 0.8) |> 
  style_tt( i=0, background=bgcol, color="white")


```
